reviews.text: Ivy tree (my dog) hates getting her nails trimmed. But taking her to hot dogs grooming, they really do make it so easy for me to feel reassured she's in good hands. Highly recommend 🤍 thank you guys and

Took my Dacshund took have his first groom.. he was looked after by Tamsin and she was amazing with him.. we had the Full Monty service and he loved it.. would definitely recommend Tamsin if you have a nervous dog.. we will be back and recommending this fantastic business to our friends Thank you Damon and Dash
Molly is so amazing,definitely recommend

I brought my Aussie Darwin to see Mollie at Hot Dogs Grooming, and she was absolutely amazing! Was nervous about finding a new groomer for him after moving house, as he’s been with the same one since he was a puppy, but she immediately made me feel at ease and comfortable, and Darwin warmed up to her straight away. She took great care of my loveable fur-ball and he came out looking (and smelling!) gorgeous! Will definitely be bringing him back, and would recommend Hot Dogs Grooming to anyone in East London looking for a groomer ☺️

Pedri just got his first full groom after 3 puppy grooms. We love it so much!
Pedri loves Patrycja, and loves coming to Hot Dogs and spend time in there 🥰
Patrycja and the team is very attentive and careful, and overall doing a great job. …

Highly highly recommend Mollie and team! Tried several popular grooming parlours around central London overtime but Hotdog’s the only place that’s been able to consistently groom my 2 pups without any faults! The attention to detail is amazing 💜  also very easy booking process and fair prices! …
Friendly service. They trimmed our dogs nails. He normally freaks out and doesn't let anybody near his nails, but they got the high done in 10-15 minutes. No problems!

Mollie, Patricia and team were extemely attentive to our needs and so sweet with our dog Mel. Mel looks amazing and was comfortable during the groom! So happy to have gone there and to support this independent business.
Always amazing look after my hooligan like he is family

5⭐️
Mollie was just lovely and my boy Sugar came out looking and smelling absolutely gorgeous. I could tell by his demeanor when I collected him that he was treated really well- he was so happy and clearly LOVED his time there.
Very kind and give a great cut.
Great dog groomers - Mollie and her team go the extra mile for the dogs. My Frenchie/Pug had a full groom and came out smelling better than he ever has.
Mollie and the team are great, my dog always looks so handsome when I get him back. And he’s happy to see them! Highly recommend. Thank you 🙏🏽🤩 …

Patrycja did an amazing cut and teeth clean for our cockapoo Odie! He’s looking extra stylish and we couldn’t be happier! 😁. His front teeth had a bit of plaque build up on prior which is gone now 🦷. Odie has separation anxiety so we were anxious when leaving him for the first time, but Patrycja was really friendly and kind, putting him at ease instantly! Thank you so much to the Patrycja and the Hot Dogs team! We couldn’t recommend them enough!

I used Hot Dog Grooming for the first time today. Firstly the customer service was brilliant. The owner actually called me back after I called a few times, she let me explain and listened to me about an ordeal my dog had gone through and offered me an appointment in a few days on a Sunday which was great for me. The communication and process was easy and great.
My dog was very nervous when we arrived but her groomer Poppy was very soft and gentle with her and i felt very comfortable leaving Kiki. My dogs coat was in a bad condition but Poppy done an amazing job making her look beautiful again 😍.
Thank you so much we appreciated today. ❤️
Wonderful service!
Love this place! They done an absolutely fantastic job on my puppy (Jackie Yorkie Poo) I couldn’t be happier and neither could my fur baby. Lovely people & great prices I’d highly recommend.

Couldn’t recommend this place more! I took our cocker spaniel Maggie there for a full groom and ultrasonic teeth clean. The owner and groomer were absolutely lovely and took great care of Maggie, who is not the bravest soul and can be anxious in new places. Maggie looked and smelled lovely when I picked her up and was happy and relaxed. Prices are very fair too. Really happy I found this place!

Thanks so much for taking care of Teddy.

Great service. Very friendly and welcoming :) communicated with me through the whole process.

my Dog needed a good clean and cut so we had the full Monty.

Will really recommend for all your grooming needs.
Rudy looks amazing after his Trim. Great service and made Rudy fell so comfortable. See you soon
Excellent service from start to finish. Lovely relaxed, welcoming environment. I felt comfortable leaving my dog with the lovely ladies and will definitely bring my dog back for a groom!

A lovely experience from start to finish. Olivia was super friendly and took great care of my toy poodle Mu. I’ve never loved a groom on Mu but Olivia nailed the brief and it’s the best she has looked 🩵 we will be back :) …

First time using hot Dogs groomers for our puppy chow chow .it was her first groom and she has come out looking beautiful smelling gorgeous 😍and super soft  the ladies there are so lovely and friendly .and the place is super clean cute little shop will defo be our regular spot .thankyou for putting us at ease with our pup 🐶 very very happy .easy to book had a slot available and is super convenient to where we are .price is fantastic and we'll worth it .

An excellent service.
Friendly, calming and personal.
A lovely, skilled cut.
Very empathic with Henry.
He was nervous going in, very happy once in their care.
Will definitely be visiting regularly.

5 star for this groomers. I absolutely love it my pups came out smelling so clean they actually smell like a baby lol my fur babies love it here, the ladies are amazing communication is on point they are so polite, friendly just perfect I will recommend to anyone who needs a groomers these guy's are the best I defo won't be going anywhere els

Everyone there is amazing and the dog comes out looking perfect and as a bonus, she loves them too 💜 I am an actual nightmare to have as a customer when it comes to bookings because my schedule is pure chaos, yet they always fit us in somehow and make it so easy and comfortable. Greatest customer service. thank you! …
Best grooming ever! Our Spaniel Jasper looks so chic and clearly is happy with the haircut all hear long! 🙌 …
Great groom, extremely easy to book and lovely staff
